Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Robert Granat wrote:
>
> Just recently, I aquired a Vtes copy of the Archon card, and noticed that
> the Vtes and Jyhad versions are significantly different.

The VtES version is official. New card text takes precedence (unless
it is errata'ed, which Archon is not).

Messages.Author: JlB1925
Messages.Body:
>Which is official, and why?

Whenever a V:TES card and a Jyhad card conflict, assume the V:TES card is
right, because unless there is errata, it is.
